speaker: AXIOM-7
text: Descent telemetry confirmed. We are four hundred meters beneath Downtown Core. The registry logs terminate at a subterranean facility designated Cyber-Grave.

speaker: KAITO
text: A grave? No. They do not bury the dead here. They process the living into machine components. Look at the conduits along the shaft.

speaker: AURA
text: The resonance down here is sickening... it’s not mechanical hum. It’s thousands of bio-signals trapped in forced synchronization. A dissonance of stolen lives.

speaker: OCEANUS
text: They told our people the relocated citizens were sent to agricultural preserves. Cages. They put them in pressurized stasis pods. Stagnant water... drowning without an ocean.

speaker: TITAN
text: The foundry uses geothermal siphon reactors. The pressure in those pipes could blow half the district above if the coolant fails. Heavy plating, blast doors... they knew someone would come to tear it down.

speaker: MIRAGE
text: Secondary security grid is active. High-energy plasma conduits and chemical vapor sluices. I've marked the access shafts. We drop through the ventilation before the blast doors seal.

speaker: SURYA
text: I'm locking our transponder signals to the orbital blind spot. Once you breach the inner vault, you will have no topside extraction. Every operative must come back together.

speaker: OCEANUS
text: Every pod will open. Not one name left behind in this dark. Shogun, give the order.

speaker: KAITO
text: We breach the perimeter, sever the conduits, and evacuate the captives. Axiom Force—engage!
